localBindings.reason: Complete stateless classification is defined once in the canonical API; it has no owner database or runtime state.

The single canonical parameter reader uses ConfigurationCatalog and scoped JobGroupContext, with no persistence, workers or platform secrets. Reused in every consuming assembly; ConfigurationCatalog lists these consumer APIs for transport wiring.

The canonical HTTP cookie adapter uses native or remote account session operations; servlet request/response and Authentication never cross HTTP as serialized values. Media owner imports the same adapter through canonical MediaSessionConfiguration.
